flavor.intro_log: A small farm. The cabin lantern in the top-right is already lit.
flavor.rain: Rain falls over the farm. Every plot is watered.
flavor.snow: Snow settles on the farm. The soil is wet beneath it.
flavor.clear: A clear day dawns over the farm.
flavor.cabin: the cabin. A warm lantern glows in the window.
flavor.cabin_short: the cabin, lantern lit in the window.
flavor.new_farm: A new farm is ready — day 1, spring, {starter}'s turn.
flavor.text_view_summary: Text view (the same one the other player reads)
flavor.web_footer: The pictures come from the same JSON state as the text view. This page plays as {web_player}. {cli_player} uses the command line. When someone acts from the CLI, this page updates on its own. Ending your turn hands the farm to the other player; the day advances when you both have ended your turn.
flavor.storm: A storm rolls over the farm. Every plot is watered.
flavor.cloud: The sky is overcast. The soil stays as you left it.
